purpose.zh: 撑在双杠上，只靠肩膀下压把身体顶高，练背部和肩膀稳定
purpose.en: Support yourself on dip bars and lift your body by pressing your shoulders down.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，肩膀往下压把身体顶高
text.en: Keep your arms straight and press your shoulders down to lift your body

text.zh: 放松时肩膀慢慢升向耳朵，手臂不弯。
text.en: Let your shoulders rise slowly toward your ears without bending your arms.

text.zh: 顶端停1秒，双腿伸直并拢。
text.en: Hold for one second at the top with your legs straight together.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘上下弯，变成双杠臂屈伸
commonErrors.en: Bending the elbows so it turns into a dip.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼时少做一会儿或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, do less or switch to an easier version.

changes: 名字「耸肩下压 / Scapular Depression」矛盾且有术语，改「双杠直臂肩下压 / Dip-Bar Shoulder Press-Down」
口令顺序按计数轨道（下压→顶端停→沉下）重排，原为「肩上升/下压顶高/顶端停住」错位
cue2 改成动画里的「放松时肩慢慢升向耳朵」
用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
